==About==

{{i|Huckleberries}} can be found in the wild or Picked from a {{i|Huckleberry Bush}}. Learning the [[Flowers & Berries]] Skill will allow you to Pick more Huckleberries from each [[Bush]]. Huckleberries can be stored a {{i|Berry Sack}}.
